rows.claim: Published request and agency response; not an appropriation or solicitation.
rows.explanation: HIRE INSPECTORS AND PLAN EXAMINERS, IN SUFFICIENT NUMBERS, TO COPE WITH ILLEGAL USES OF PROPERTY AND QUESTIONABLE CONSTRUCTION A separate afternoon/evening and weekend inspection team of 10 inspectors for Queens is critical because inspectors very often can't gain access in the daytime during the work-week. Communities throughout Queens have been plagued with illegal apartments posing dangerous conditions, school overcrowding and more pressure on limited City services. Construction inspectors and plan examiners in adequate numbers are needed to curtail contractors building homes larger than the zoning permits. Currently to our knowledge, Queens has 26 plan examiners and only 15 construction inspectors usually working in the borough.
rows.headline: Assign additional building inspectors (including expanding training programs)
rows.response: OMB supports the agency's position as follows: Agency supports and can accommodate Explanation: Agency will continue with existing resources and funding. The agency recruits and train staff to enforce the building code.
